_about: Chronicle fragment (List 23 #224) — in-world print media over #172's broadcast family. Editions are derived publications: every item carries its source record. The load-bearing law is the belief/record split: the chronicle is reputation's public source (what the paper prints is what the world believes), the paper can err, the record cannot, and a correction is a new item citing the erring one — the erring item is never silently rewritten.

belief_record_split.belief: the chronicle's items — what NPCs believe before meeting a Ranger; correctable by a later correction item
belief_record_split.law: systems reading TRUTH read records; systems reading BELIEF read the chronicle; confusing the two is the wiring error this package exists to prevent
belief_record_split.record: fixtures, deed facts (#12), individual histories — append-only, never edited

classes: phenomena (projections labelled as such — #142's no-forecasting-fiction law)
forest_bulletin (TRACE class only, #163 — the paper prints what was heard at the edge, never a depths fact)
edition: {editionId, regionRef, issuedBeat, items: [{class, subjectRef, sourceRef}]} — an item without a resolvable sourceRef cannot be printed; issuance derived at read time over #19's clock (#124 discipline, as #172's airing)
open_register: error rate + correction culture (a tone decision, not a format constant)
letters/reader content (a class addition by ruling only; none founded)
back-issue collectables: #31-class item proposal — lands only as an edit in #31's home; until then editions are media records, not inventory
reputation_join: the chronicle is #201 reputation's public source (its loudest input) — #201's package was not in the workspace at build time; join registered UNVERIFIED in STAGING, lands as a citation proposal in #201's home
